correctness.rationale: PASS. The finite Petersen M_2(P) has 15 edge-vertices and faces exactly the edge sets with all ten graph degrees <=2. Independent reconstruction checked all 32768 subsets and obtained 10870 faces and cardinality vector (1,15,105,445,1245,2358,2985,2400,1095,215,6). A fresh sequential-toggle matching of the augmented face poset yields 5433 pairs and four cardinality-8 critical faces; removing the empty/singleton pair gives 5432 ordinary matched pairs, one critical vertex and four critical 7-simplices. Independently directed all 63780 covers and topologically sorted 10869 nonempty faces, proving acyclicity, hence X is a wedge of four 7-spheres. A separate all-120-permutation signed fixed-face computation verifies the seven conjugacy-class traces (4,2,0,1,-1,0,-1); simplex signs follow (-1)^(|F|-number_of_orbits). Lefschetz concentration in degree 7 yields trace fixed_points(sigma)-1 and rational Maschke semisimplicity identifies the standard Specht S^(4,1) module. This is NOT an assertion of equivariant wedge homotopy or integral lattice splitting.
